_transcription: ENGLISH half only, CBSE Class 10 Science (086). 27 pages: idx 0 cover, idx 1 Hindi instructions, idx 2 English instructions + Q1-2; English on EVERY EVEN index 2-26, Hindi on every odd index (each the Hindi of the page after it); odd-page tops checked on the contact sheet, all Hindi; last page idx 26 English. This paper's instruction (viii) prints NO count of internal choices, so the roster was built by walking the marking scheme (31/1/1 block, pages 0-11 of the series file): OR after Q23, 25, 28, 34, 35, 36, 37, 38, 39 = 9 alternatives, each confirmed against a printed OR on the paper. All 20 Section-A answers are CBSE's own, read off that scheme; each was also re-derived and agrees. Decimal points on this paper are RAISED (Q36: 2{\cdot}5). Opener of series 31/1: nothing skipped.
